_comment: The emtk layout of the ALEX Creator: the same controls as alex.view.json (file, formats, period/shift, batch) drawn by emtk.view_form with the app as the model. Number fields are spin fields (typed value or arrows or wheel); the batch queue is a data_table.

sections.label: File
sections.description: Path of the TTTR file to convert. Press Enter (or click elsewhere) to load it; a file dropped on the window loads too.

buttons.label: Open…
buttons.description: Choose a TTTR file and preview its folded ALEX phase.

buttons.label: Save as…
buttons.description: Write the converted photon data to a new file; the input is never overwritten. Grey until a file is loaded.

sections.label: Input
sections.description: Force the input container type, or Auto to detect it from the file.

sections.label: Output
sections.description: Container format written when saving (differs from input: transcode).

sections.label: Period
sections.description: ALEX alternation period (macro-time units) mapped onto micro-time.

sections.label: Shift
sections.description: Phase shift of the ALEX period before the macro-time to micro-time mapping.
Number of photon events of the loaded file.

sections.label: Mode
sections.description: Convert every file to its own ALEX output, or merge them all into one.

buttons.label: Add files…
buttons.description: Queue TTTR files; duplicate paths are ignored.

buttons.label: Folder…
buttons.description: Queue the supported TTTR files of a folder, scanned recursively.

buttons.label: Database
buttons.description: Queue TTTR data from the session database.

buttons.label: Remove
buttons.description: Remove the selected file from the queue; the file stays on disk. Grey until a row is selected.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Empty the queue without deleting files.

sections.description: The queued files, in the order they are converted or merged. Click a row to select it, Delete removes it, the wheel scrolls.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The file name; hover a row for the full path.

columns.title: Folder
columns.tooltip: The folder the file is in.

sections.label: Output folder
sections.description: Convert requires a folder; merge defaults to the folder of the first input.

buttons.label: Run batch
buttons.description: Convert each file or merge the queue using the current period, shift and formats.
